title: The Easiest $3K/Day Business Nobody Is Talking About
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The guest sells photo-magnet machines, kits, refill supplies and courses (Shopify course, live events course, a full course in progress) to people copying the business, and says she shares the method because she believes the market will not get oversaturated. The host earns from audience growth by pushing 'anyone could start this' stories.

stated_problem.quote: I'd love to look back on those on those memories more, but I don't want to cover my walls in picture frames.
stated_problem.speaker: Sarai

idea.name: Custom photo magnets (online + markets)
idea.one_liner: Make custom photo magnets from customers' own photos. Sell them in packs through the brand's website and live at craft and farmers markets, at about a 91% gross margin on small magnets.
idea.customer: Consumers who want to display personal photos (families, couples, gift buyers)
idea.offer: Square or rectangle fridge magnets printed from uploaded photos, sold in 9-packs, made live at markets or shipped
idea.revenue_model: Per-pack product sales (e.g. $25 for 9) online and at market stalls, with repeat buyers

key_quotes.quote: And I came across mag the magnets and I found a machine that made them.
a lot of just showing us making the product is probably what we do most
that is actually a huge way to get revenue is handing your business cards at markets

claims.quote: And so that first month, I think I made a little over $1,000.

claims.claim: Gross margin on the smallest magnets is about 91%
claims.quote: Um for our smallest magnets, it's like 91%.

claims.claim: $1.63M online revenue in the first full year (all business lines)
claims.quote: So last year we did 1.63 million.

claims.quote: 30 to 40% net profit margins.

claims.quote: This month, we did 104,000 in revenue.

claims.quote: I would say 50 to 300 is what I do.

claims.quote: So, yeah, I was paying the high school girls $12 an hour.

claims.quote: you can find them on sale frequently for like $550, but really any inkjet printer will do.

acquisition_channels.details: Craft and farmers market stalls with live making, plus business cards that bring online orders over the next 5 days
Consistent short-form videos showing the product being made
Repeat buyers from markets and weddings; a QR-code logo magnet goes in every order

ideas.delivery: The founder and family, with paid high-school helpers, print photos on an inkjet printer and press the magnets with a manual machine. Orders are made live at markets or shipped from home.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Consumer Contracts Regulations (personalised goods are exempt from the 14-day cancellation right). UK GDPR for storing customers' photos. Local-authority child employment rules if using under-16 helpers. Market trader / street trading licences from councils.

idea.name: Live photo-magnet station at weddings/events
idea.one_liner: Couples or event hosts pay a flat or per-hour fee. Guests get free photo magnets printed on site as wedding favours.
idea.customer: Engaged couples and private or organisational event hosts (baby showers, graduations, parties)
idea.offer: 2-4 hour on-site magnet station with backdrop: guests upload photos and staff print and press magnets
idea.revenue_model: Event fee of $1,200-3,000 per wedding (bulk magnet rate plus about $50/hour per staff member, or a flat fee). Smaller events are $300-500.

we haven't really done any outreach other than posting about it once or twice.
quite a few people have had success going to expose, things like that.

claims.quote: We typically do a bit higher at like $50 an hour.

acquisition_channels.details: The first wedding came from a couple who bought at a market
Posted wedding footage once or twice; inbound emails followed
Wedding expos are mentioned as working for others

ideas.delivery: 1-4 people on site with a printer, press machine, backdrop and a QR upload tool. Guests' phone photos are printed and pressed live.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR for guest photos uploaded and stored. Public liability insurance is usually required by venues. Consumer Contracts Regulations for booking and deposit terms.

idea.name: Photo-magnet starter kits, machines and refills
idea.one_liner: Sell magnet-making machines and starter kits, with a lifetime warranty and business support, to people starting their own magnet side hustle. Refill supplies bring repeat sales.
idea.customer: Aspiring side-hustlers, especially stay-at-home or new mums
idea.offer: Machine kits in several sizes, refill supplies, new product formats (restickable backing, round pins, bottle openers), lifetime warranty
idea.revenue_model: Higher-ticket machine sales at about 30% margin, plus low-margin refill consumables

key_quotes.quote: so we sell them the machine and then we also sell refill supplies.
We have like a lifetime warranty on all of our kits.
there are a ton of people now that have these kits.

claims.claim: Machine margin is about 30% after all costs
claims.quote: They're probably said and done about 30%.

claims.claim: Refills earn little and are offered for convenience
claims.quote: Um we don't make a ton on it, but it's there for convenience.

claims.claim: A kit buyer reportedly makes an unstated amount per month
claims.quote: she bought a kit and now she's making x amount a month

acquisition_channels.details: Social accounts and inbound messages from people who want to copy the business
Facebook groups and a community of magnet makers
Kit buyers meet her at markets, though machines are not sold at markets

ideas.delivery: Machines and supplies are shipped to buyers, with warranty replacements and business-support content. The machines appear to be sourced from manufacturers.

tools: magnet press machines (multiple sizes, round machine)

ideas.other_uk_rules: General Product Safety Regulations and UKCA for imported machines. Consumer Rights Act and Consumer Contracts Regulations. Earnings claims to kit buyers are covered by the CAP Code and DMCC Act unfair-practice rules.

idea.name: Photo-magnet business courses
idea.one_liner: Courses that teach would-be magnet entrepreneurs Shopify setup, live events, business registration and growing sales.
idea.customer: Kit buyers and aspiring magnet-business owners
idea.offer: Shopify course, live events course, and a full end-to-end business course in progress

key_quotes.quote: we already have a Shopify course for people who don't know how to build a Shopify website.
We already have like a live events course on how to do live events.

ideas.delivery: Recorded course content made by the founder
ideas.other_uk_rules: Income claims are covered by the CAP Code and DMCC Act 2024 unfair-commercial-practice rules. Consumer Contracts Regulations apply to the cancellation right for digital content.

idea.name: Import from manufacturers and resell with local support
idea.one_liner: Buy products from manufacturers or import them from China and resell at a markup. Buyers pay the premium for trust, warranty, returns and support from a domestic seller.
idea.customer: Domestic consumers who distrust buying direct from overseas
idea.offer: Imported products with a local warranty, returns and support

key_quotes.quote: how much opportunity there is simply to like buy things from a manufacturer or to import things from China and to resell them.
And it's like because that's friction.

ideas.delivery: Sourcing, warehousing, shipping and after-sales support
ideas.other_uk_rules: The importer carries product-safety duties (GPSR, UKCA/CE, WEEE for electricals) plus customs/VAT and Consumer Rights Act

idea.name: QR photo-upload and ordering software for event print vendors
idea.one_liner: Software for live-print vendors (photo-magnet makers at markets and weddings). Guests scan a QR code, upload, crop and pay, and the photo drops into a print-ready template, so one person can run the stall. My interpretation: she built it in-house, and selling it to the many kit owners is not stated.
idea.customer: Photo-magnet and live-print event vendors (e.g. her kit buyers)
idea.offer: Web app: QR upload, self-crop, auto-templating, payment, print queue
idea.revenue_model: Not stated; plausibly a subscription or per-event licence

key_quotes.quote: a software that actually allows people to just scan a QR code, upload their photo, crop it themselves how they want
So, the software, they pay through the software.
if we would have had the like something the software, I definitely could have done it myself.

claims.claim: With the software, one person can run an event station

ideas.delivery: Hosted web app run by the founder
